lines.en: I am a size smaller than my kin.
I pad along the bamboo, step by step.

lines.zh: 我的毛色淡，藏在叶影里。
lines.en: My coat is pale and hides in the leaf shade.

lines.zh: 我尾巴垫在身后，走得稳。
lines.en: My tail trails behind and steadies me.

lines.zh: 我沿着稀树的坡往上走。
lines.en: I climb the sparsely wooded slope.
My pads land without a sound on the leaves.
I squeeze between the bamboo poles.
I step slowly over a cross vine.
Every two steps I look up.

lines.zh: 影子在苔上一点一点移。
lines.en: My shadow inches across the moss.
I skirt a fern and go on.
Small prints stay in the damp soil.
I walk toward the sound of water.
I crouch as the wind ruffles my coat.
I gnaw an old stalk of bamboo.
I lift my head; my nose is wet.
My ears turn twice.
The mist is heavier here than elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我把自己团成小半个球。
lines.en: I curl into a small half-ball.
I chew slowly, eyes half shut.
A wet leaf clings to my back.
I listen to a distant drip.

lines.zh: 我伸爪挠了挠耳朵后面。
lines.en: I scratch behind my ear.
Only wind is left in the quiet bamboo.
I tidy the white fur on my forepaws.
I look at my own shadow.
My tail hangs loose.
I am not as round as my kin.
Crouch, and I can see you properly.
You smell of bamboo forest.
I tilt my head, one ear twitching.
Is there bamboo in your hand?
I am not used to strangers.
Your shadow is far bigger than mine.
Let me sniff your fingertips first.
Go slowly; I startle easily.
You are looking at the colour of my coat.
I am much lighter than I look.

lines.zh: 你别站在我唯一的路上。
lines.en: Do not stand in my only path.
I can recognize your footsteps now.

lines.zh: 你笑起来，我就不那么怕。
lines.en: When you smile, I fear you less.
Will you give me a name?
There is still dew on me.
You reach out; I step back half a pace.
It is cold here; your hand is warm.
I will follow, but at a distance.
I take hits worse than my kin.
A tuft of pale fur falls.
I lie on the branch and pant.
My ears are pressed flat.
I lick the wound on my paw.
Stop; I am too small for this.
I shrink into the hollow.
It hurts too much to come down.
I can smell tender shoots.
I am small; I cannot eat much.
Lower the bamboo.
I reach out with a front paw.
This stalk is thicker than my arm.
I hug it and cannot bite through.
Swap it for a thinner one.
The taste is clean; I like it.
I gnaw once and glance at you.
Don't take it all; leave half.
I drag it to the base of the tree.
When I am full, I roll over.
This leaf is a little yellow.
The warmth of your palm is just right.
I want more, but I am not greedy.
I loop my tail around the bamboo.
I eat until my face is covered in scraps.

lines.zh: 你差一点踩到我这小身子。
lines.en: You nearly trod on this small body.
I am small; I easily bump into feet.
The bump fluffs my coat out.
You lift a leg and I back away.
I rub against you once.
We meet, very lightly.
I slip, then hold.
Don't crowd me against the stone.

lines.zh: 你踩断的树枝弹了我一下。
lines.en: A snapped branch flicks me.
After the bump I shake my back.
I am a year younger than my kin.
There is no suitable one in this bamboo.
I do not really understand this.
I bury my face in my tail.
You asked too suddenly.
I only know how to find bamboo.
With a flick of my tail I turn around.
Ask again when the mist clears.
I am clumsy with this topic.
I leap up the tree and escape it.
I pick it up with small paws.
It is bigger than one of my paws.
Too heavy; I carry it in my teeth.
I hide it among the roots.
I sniff; not bamboo.
It rolls downhill and I chase it.
I hug it as I climb.
Could I sleep on this?
I try a bite; it will not give.
There; kept by my cheek.
The bamboo leaves have gone still.
Something is down the slope.
I lower my head and look.
I have that shadow fixed.
This smell is unfamiliar.
My ears stay pointed that way.
First I shift to a higher branch.
I hold my breath and keep still.
If you heard it too, back away.
I turn with it from the branch.
I press the leaves still and stay quiet.
It rounds a tree; I shift.
I am smaller; I must look first.

lines.zh: 它要是上来，我就跳到旁边。
lines.en: If it climbs, I jump across.
My tail is taut and still.
I edge back into the mist.
It has stopped at the bottom.
Wait a little and it will go.
I swat its nose tip.
I bite the tip of its ear.
I am weak; enough only to scare it.
It lunges; I dive into the bamboo.
I flick my tail at its eyes.
I land one swipe, then run.
Its hide is too thick.
It does not follow; I relax.
I swipe its leg once more.
The bamboo is tall. I only reach the joints.
I land on a low branch.

lines.zh: 这儿的竹子比我高太多。
lines.en: The bamboo here is far taller than me.
I shake the water from my coat.
First, let me see if kin are near.
The air is cool; I draw myself in.
My pads press new soil.
I am even smaller than I expected.
Bamboo leaves rustle in the distance.
I raise my head slowly and look around.

lines.zh: 火苗碰到我的淡毛，一下卷起来。
lines.en: Flame touches my pale coat and curls it.

lines.zh: 我从高枝掉下来，摔在苔上。
lines.en: I drop from a high branch onto the moss.

lines.zh: 炸响把我震得贴在树干上。
lines.en: The blast pins me against the trunk.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的后腿，划开皮。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my hind leg and opens the skin.

lines.zh: 那股气钻进毛里，我发抖。
lines.en: That force seeps into my fur and I shiver.

lines.zh: 找不到嫩笋，我越来越轻。
lines.en: No tender shoots; I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷声太大，我缩在树根下。
lines.en: The thunder is huge; I cower among the roots.
